firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently earned glory in battle starts. Choosing a player randomly is also an official option.
clarifications: Give that player the First Player Marker. Leader selection begins with their right-hand neighbor and goes counterclockwise; actual worker placement starts with the marker holder and proceeds clockwise.
The marker changes hands through the Jarl's Longhouse action. Taking that action while already holding the marker passes it to your left; the marker does not automatically rotate each round.
interpretation: The cited instruction does not define what counts as earning glory in battle. Agree on its meaning together, or use the official random option.
